objectives.summary: The project aims to develop a QR code-based payment application named Meghnad, focusing on the North American market. Its primary objectives include protecting users from credit/debit card fraud, saving transaction fees for small vendors, and providing a hassle-free payment solution for busy, tech-savvy users. The project has a funding goal of $61,455 and is currently 107% funded with 10 days left in the funding period.
